description:
Title: Building a House

You want to build a tree house.
First you collect your requirements, and send them to a tree house architect.
The architect sends you back a draft, which you refine multiple times with additional requirements.
You then create the list of needed materials from the plan.
These materials fall into several categories, you order them from several online stores.
While the order is processed, you send messages to several of your friends to build the house.
After the house is built, you send invitations for a tree house party to your friends.
In order to buy the snacks for the party, a list of people that attend the party is created.

<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="Definitions_TreeHouse" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/treehouse">
  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_TreeHouse">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_You" name="You" processRef="Process_You"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Architect" name="Tree House Architect"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_OnlineStores" name="Online Stores"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Friends" name="Friends"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_RequirementsToArchitect" name="Requirements" sourceRef="SendTask_SendRequirements" targetRef="Participant_Architect"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_DraftFromArchitect" name="Draft" sourceRef="Participant_Architect" targetRef="IntermediateCatchEvent_DraftReceived"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_AdditionalRequirementsToArchitect" name="Additional requirements" sourceRef="SendTask_SendAdditionalRequirements" targetRef="Participant_Architect"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_RevisedDraftFromArchitect" name="Revised draft" sourceRef="Participant_Architect" targetRef="IntermediateCatchEvent_RevisedDraftReceived"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_OrderToStores" name="Material order" sourceRef="UserTask_OrderMaterials" targetRef="Participant_OnlineStores"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_BuildRequestToFriends" name="Build request" sourceRef="SendTask_SendFriendsMessages" targetRef="Participant_Friends"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_HouseBuiltFromFriends" name="House built" sourceRef="Participant_Friends" targetRef="IntermediateCatchEvent_HouseBuilt"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_InvitationToFriends" name="Party invitation" sourceRef="SendTask_SendPartyInvitations" targetRef="Participant_Friends"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_You" name="Building a Tree House" isExecutable="false">

    <bpmn:userTask id="UserTask_CollectRequirements" name="Collect requirements"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_SendRequirements" name="Send requirements to architect"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="IntermediateCatchEvent_DraftReceived" name="Draft received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_DraftReceived"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Review_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="UserTask_ReviewDraft" name="Review draft"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Further_Split" name="Further requirements?" default="SF_10"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_SendAdditionalRequirements" name="Send additional requirements to architect"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="IntermediateCatchEvent_RevisedDraftReceived" name="Revised draft received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_RevisedDraftReceived"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CreateMaterialsList" name="Create list of needed materials from plan"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="UserTask_OrderMaterials" name="Order materials from online stores"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_SendFriendsMessages" name="Send messages to friends">
      <bpmn:documentation>To build the house</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="IntermediateCatchEvent_HouseBuilt" name="House is built">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_HouseBuilt"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_SendPartyInvitations" name="Send party invitations to friends"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CreateAttendeeList" name="Create list of party attendees">
      <bpmn:documentation>In order to buy the snacks for the party</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_AttendeeListCreated" name="Attendee list created"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_01" sourceRef="StartEvent_WantHouse" targetRef="UserTask_CollectRequirements"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_02" sourceRef="UserTask_CollectRequirements" targetRef="SendTask_SendRequirements"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_03" sourceRef="SendTask_SendRequirements" targetRef="IntermediateCatchEvent_DraftReceived"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_04" sourceRef="IntermediateCatchEvent_DraftReceived" targetRef="Gateway_Review_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_05" sourceRef="Gateway_Review_Merge" targetRef="UserTask_ReviewDraft"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_06" sourceRef="UserTask_ReviewDraft" targetRef="Gateway_Further_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_07" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_Further_Split" targetRef="SendTask_SendAdditionalRequirements"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_08" sourceRef="SendTask_SendAdditionalRequirements" targetRef="IntermediateCatchEvent_RevisedDraftReceived"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_09" sourceRef="IntermediateCatchEvent_RevisedDraftReceived" targetRef="Gateway_Review_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_10" name="No, plan approved" sourceRef="Gateway_Further_Split" targetRef="Task_CreateMaterialsList"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_11" sourceRef="Task_CreateMaterialsList" targetRef="UserTask_OrderMaterials"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_12" sourceRef="UserTask_OrderMaterials" targetRef="SendTask_SendFriendsMessages"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_13" sourceRef="SendTask_SendFriendsMessages" targetRef="IntermediateCatchEvent_HouseBuilt"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_14" sourceRef="IntermediateCatchEvent_HouseBuilt" targetRef="SendTask_SendPartyInvitations"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_15" sourceRef="SendTask_SendPartyInvitations" targetRef="Task_CreateAttendeeList"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_16" sourceRef="Task_CreateAttendeeList" targetRef="EndEvent_AttendeeListCreated"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
